zh.text: 如果蚊子跟鴿子一樣大？
一隻蚊子約兩毫克，鴿子約三百克。
十五萬隻蚊子，才跟一隻鴿子一樣重。
叮一口，大約吸走三毫克的血，
放大十五萬倍，就是大約四百二十五毫升。
叮一口，差不多就是捐一袋血。
你全身的血，大約五公升。
被叮五口，就少了超過四成，
不過這麼大一隻，你一定看得到。
但真正的蚊子只有兩毫克，小到你根本沒發現。
蚊子傳播的瘧疾，2024 年奪走了六十一萬人。
大蚊子要你的血，小蚊子要你的命。
所以下次那一巴掌，別客氣。

en.text: What if mosquitoes were the size of pigeons?
How much blood would one bite take?
Mosquito: about 2 milligrams. Pigeon: about 300 grams.
It takes 150,000 to match one pigeon.
One bite takes about 3 milligrams of blood.
One bite is about one blood donation.
You have about 5 liters of blood.
Five bites, and you've lost over 40 percent.
But one this big? You'd see it coming.
Real mosquitoes weigh just 2 milligrams. Too small to even notice.
Big ones take your blood. Small ones take your life.
So next time, don't hold back the slap.
